BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC has purchased 1,000,000 ordinary shares as part of its $250 million share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between July 20 and July 24, 2026, at prices ranging from 1,523.0000 pence to 1,595.0000 pence. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and following these transactions, the total number of issued ordinary shares will be 210,729,832, with the total voting rights remaining the same. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 27 July 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 20 July 2026 to 24 July 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 11,156,621 ordinary shares at a total cost of £154,008,119.15. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 210,729,832 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 210,729,832.
